**Enhanced Code**:
```java
@Transactional
public QuizAttempt submitAttempt(UUID attemptId, Map<UUID, String> answers) {
    QuizAttempt attempt = attemptRepository.findById(attemptId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new RuntimeException("Attempt not found"));

    if (attempt.getStatus() != QuizAttempt.Status.IN_PROGRESS) {
        throw new RuntimeException("Attempt đã được nộp");
    }

    // Update answers và auto-grade
    for (QuizAttemptItem item : attempt.getItems()) {
        String selectedOption = answers.get(item.getQuestion().getId());
        item.setSelectedOption(selectedOption);
        item.setIsCorrect(selectedOption != null &&
                          selectedOption.equals(item.getQuestion().getCorrectOption()));
        if (item.getIsCorrect()) {
            attempt.setCorrectAnswers(attempt.getCorrectAnswers() + 1);
        }
    }

    // Calculate score
    double score = (double) attempt.getCorrectAnswers() / attempt.getTotalQuestions() * 100;
    attempt.setScore(score);
    attempt.setIsPassed(score >= attempt.getQuiz().getPassingScore());
    attempt.setStatus(QuizAttempt.Status.SUBMITTED);
    attempt.setEndTime(Instant.now());

    // ✅ NEW: Update StudentLessonProgress if quiz passed
    if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(attempt.getIsPassed())) {
        Lesson lesson = attempt.getQuiz().getLesson();
        User student = attempt.getStudent();
        
        try {
            // Use existing domain service to update progress
            progressDomainService.completeLesson(student, lesson);
            
            // Log successful progress update
            log.info("Quiz completed and progress updated - Student: {}, Lesson: {}, Score: {}", 
                    student.getId(), lesson.getId(), score);
                    
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Failed to update progress after quiz completion - Student: {}, Lesson: {}, Error: {}", 
                     student.getId(), lesson.getId(), e.getMessage());
            // Don't fail the entire transaction, but log the error
        }
    }

    return attemptRepository.save(attempt);
}
```

```java
@GetMapping("/attempts/{attemptId}/result")
@Operation(summary = "Xem kết quả chi tiết của quiz", 
           description = "Học viên xem kết quả với thông tin progress")
public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<EnhancedQuizResultResponse>> getEnhancedQuizResult(
        @PathVariable UUID attemptId,
        @AuthenticationPrincipal User currentUser
) {
    try {
        QuizService.QuizResultDetail basicResult = quizService.getQuizResult(attemptId, currentUser.getId());
        
        // Enhance with progress information
        Lesson lesson = quizService.getQuizByLessonId(basicResult.getQuizId()).getLesson();
        Course course = lesson.getSection().getCourse();
        
        StudentLessonProgressDTO lessonProgress = convertToDTO(
            progressDomainService.getLessonProgress(currentUser, lesson).orElse(null)
        );
        
        CourseProgressDTO courseProgress = convertToDTO(
            progressDomainService.calculateCourseProgress(currentUser, course)
        );
        
        EnhancedQuizResultResponse enhancedResponse = EnhancedQuizResultResponse.builder()
                .attemptId(attemptId)
                .score(basicResult.getScore())
                .isPassed(basicResult.getIsPassed())
                .passingScore(basicResult.getPassingScore())
                .completedAt(basicResult.getEndTime())
                .lessonProgress(lessonProgress)
                .courseProgress(courseProgress)
                .resultItems(basicResult.getResultItems())
                .build();
                
        return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.success(enhancedResponse));
        
    } catch (RuntimeException e) {
        return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(ApiResponse.error(e.getMessage()));
    }
}
```

```java
package com.example.lms.event;

import com.example.lms.domain.event.QuizCompletedEvent;
import com.example.lms.entity.User;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;

import org.springframework.context.event.EventListener;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class QuizProgressUpdateListener {
    
    private final UserRepository userRepository;
    
    @EventListener
    public void handleQuizCompleted(QuizCompletedEvent event) {
        log.info("Quiz completed event received - Student: {}, Lesson: {}, Score: {}", 
                event.studentId(), event.lessonId(), event.score());
        
        // Here you could add additional logic:
        // - Send notifications
        // - Update analytics
        // - Trigger certificates
        // - Update leaderboards
        
        // For now, just log the event
        User student = userRepository.findById(event.studentId()).orElse(null);
        if (student != null) {
            log.debug("Student {} completed quiz {} with score {}", 
                     student.getFullName(), event.quizId(), event.score());
        }
    }
}
```

#### Step 3.1: Create Application Layer
**File**: `api/src/main/java/com/example/lms/application/service/StudentProgressApplicationService.java`

```java
package com.example.lms.application.service;

import com.example.lms.entity.*;
import com.example.lms.service.LessonProgressDomainService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.util.UUID;

@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class StudentProgressApplicationService {
    
    private final LessonProgressDomainService progressDomainService;
    
    /**
     * Use case: Complete lesson (either manually or via quiz)
     */
    @Transactional
    public StudentLessonProgress completeLesson(User student, Lesson lesson) {
        // Business logic coordination
        return progressDomainService.completeLesson(student, lesson);
    }
    
    /**
     * Use case: Get next lesson to continue learning
     */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public UUID getNextLessonToContinue(User student, Course course) {
        return progressDomainService.getNextLessonToContinue(student, course);
    }
    
    /**
     * Use case: Calculate course progress
     */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public LessonProgressDomainService.CourseProgress calculateCourseProgress(
            User student, Course course) {
        return progressDomainService.calculateCourseProgress(student, course);
    }
}
```

#### Step 3.3: Add Value Objects
**File**: `api/src/main/java/com/example/lms/domain/valueobject/ProgressPercentage.java`

```java
package com.example.lms.domain.valueobject;

import lombok.EqualsAndHashCode;

@EqualsAndHashCode
public class ProgressPercentage {
    private final java.math.BigDecimal value;
    
    private ProgressPercentage(java.math.BigDecimal value) {
        if (value.compareTo(java.math.BigDecimal.ZERO) < 0 || 
            value.compareTo(java.math.BigDecimal.valueOf(100)) > 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Progress percentage must be between 0 and 100");
        }
        this.value = value;
    }
    
    public static ProgressPercentage of(java.math.BigDecimal percentage) {
        return new ProgressPercentage(percentage);
    }
    
    public static ProgressPercentage zero() {
        return new ProgressPercentage(java.math.BigDecimal.ZERO);
    }
    
    public java.math.BigDecimal getValue() {
        return value;
    }
    
    public boolean isCompleted() {
        return value.compareTo(java.math.BigDecimal.valueOf(100)) == 0;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.example.lms.service;

import com.example.lms.entity.*;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;

import java.util.UUID;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

@SpringBootTest
@Transactional
class QuizServiceIntegrationTest {
    
    @Autowired
    private QuizService quizService;
    
    @Autowired
    private StudentLessonProgressRepository progressRepository;
    
    @Test
    void shouldUpdateProgress_whenQuizPassed() {
        // Arrange
        User student = createTestStudent();
        Lesson lesson = createTestLesson();
        Course course = lesson.getSection().getCourse();
        enrollStudentInCourse(student, course);
        
        Quiz quiz = createTestQuiz(lesson);
        QuizAttempt attempt = quizService.startAttempt(student, lesson.getId());
        
        // Act - Submit correct answers
        Map<UUID, String> correctAnswers = createCorrectAnswers();
        QuizAttempt submittedAttempt = quizService.submitAttempt(attempt.getId(), correctAnswers);
        
        // Assert
        assertTrue(submittedAttempt.getIsPassed());
        
        // Verify progress was updated
        var progressOpt = progressRepository.findByStudentAndLesson(student, lesson);
        assertTrue(progressOpt.isPresent());
        assertEquals(StudentLessonProgress.ProgressStatus.COMPLETED, 
                    progressOpt.get().getStatus());
    }
    
    @Test
    void shouldNotUpdateProgress_whenQuizFailed() {

    }
}
```

```java
package com.example.lms.metrics;

import io.micrometer.core.instrument.Counter;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class StudentDomainMetrics {
    
    private final MeterRegistry meterRegistry;
    
    public void recordQuizCompleted(UUID studentId, Double score, Boolean passed) {
        meterRegistry.counter("quiz.completed", 
            "studentId", studentId.toString(),
            "passed", passed.toString()
        ).increment();
    }
    
    public void recordProgressUpdated(UUID studentId, UUID courseId) {
        meterRegistry.counter("progress.updated",
            "studentId", studentId.toString(),
            "courseId", courseId.toString()
        ).increment();
    }
}
```
